entities.summary: Thomas Lubanga Dyilo (b. 1960-12-29, Djugu Territory) was a public servant or civil administrator of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Djugu Territory and Democratic Republic of the Congo. Known in the fields of democratic republic of the congo, military leaders & commanders, africa.
